# One-word command clips for the Pi (proxy test)

20 clips from Google Speech Commands v2 (Warden, arXiv:1804.03209), licence CC BY 4.0, chosen at random (seed 1), not by score: 10 x "stop", 5 x "no", 5 x "up". Named `reply-NN.wav` so `scripts/pi_echo_check.py selftest --clips tests/fixtures/pi_stop` plays them. Read the result inversely: in this test a Silero onset on a clip means the word *was heard* through the speaker-to-microphone chain.
